attempts.label: a1-lr
attempts.hypothesis: flow-chains habit: lr for a five-rank chain, one dot per hop, labels in the horizontal rank gaps

check.ok: ok: nodes=6 edges=6 flows=6 direction=lr theme=gruvbox
check.near-misses: near-misses: 0 cell(s) inside the 2-cell margin of a node the route does not serve (0 on trunk buses)
check.labels: labels: 4/4 placed, 0 leader-ticked, 0 on route, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners
check.dots: dots: 6 single-dot routes, 0 periodic routes, 0 violations, 6 constant at 0.5c/step, 0 same-arrival at 2000ms
check.dot hues: dot hues: 6 by source, 0 by destination, 1 shared-hue pair(s) (source-only 1, destination-only 1)
check.origins: origins: 6/6 routes start at their arrow origin
check.arrivals: arrivals: 0/0 same-arrival routes show their dot at the arrowhead on the final step

attempts.measured: check extent=89x9; the pinned 77x47 dump prints 'canvas 78x9 at 100% · drag to pan' and Postgres sits past the right edge
attempts.rejected_because: the chain is five ranks wide (cli, api, {auth, queue}, worker, db) and there is no rank the source lets me remove, so lr needs 89 columns against a 77-column pane. The pinned dump proves the overflow and the clipped db, it is not a fit attempt that could be tuned.
defects: db clipped past the right edge

The frame audit on its 77x47 40-frame dump FAILS: 'routes run at different rates: 0.000..0.500 cells/frame', because label_slot collapsed the api->auth hop to a 2-3 cell route (audit route r2: start [18,37] end [19,34], rate 0.000).

verbs flush against dots and one arrowhead
